_comment: U9 wave 8, capture: is Capture offered once the hulk is damaged? Pilots w8_cap (Kit Ring Crawler, crew 10, one Kit Escort Gun turret: 30 damage every 20 frames) / w8_cap_crew (crew 500) at Kit Board Pointer (the 50,000 crew-1 Kit Hulk Pointer, 300 armor), or w8_cap_h20 (sÿst 2037: the same hulk with crew 20). Tab targets the hulk; 150 px out the turret fires for 2900 ms (about 5 shots, 150 of its 300 armor), then the walk goes on; at the first unanswered press (misaligned, see board_sweep.json) it turns in place about 5 degrees between presses until the dialog opens; the dialog (Capture Odds) is shot and closed with Abort.
